svg.title: Craft: the backend semantic atlas
svg.desc: Thirteen large illustrated definition cards above seventeen directed relationship signatures. Pulses highlight connected definitions and relationships in a twelve-second reading loop.
svg.text: 13 meta-types. Each carries meaning. Every connection has a direction.
